news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹16.13 (vs ₹2.13 in 3Q 2025)

Revenue is forecast to grow 14% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 18% growth forecast for the Specialty Retail industry in India.

news.title: New major risk - Revenue and earnings growth
news.body: Earnings are forecast to decline by an average of 5.9% per year for the foreseeable future. This is considered a major risk. Ultimately, shareholders want to see a good return on their investment and that generally comes from sharing in the company's profits. If profits are expected to decline, then in most cases the share price will decline over time as well. In addition, if the company pays dividends it will also likely need to reduce or cut them, striking a dual blow to total shareholder returns. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Debt is not well covered by operating cash flow (currently running at an operating cash loss). Earnings are forecast to decline by an average of 5.9% per year for the foreseeable future.

news.title: Senco Gold Limited (NSEI:SENCO) agreed to acquire an unknown stake in August Jewellery Private Limited.
news.body:
Senco Gold Limited (NSEI:SENCO) agreed to acquire an unknown stake in August Jewellery Private Limited on January 21, 2026. A cash consideration will be paid by Senco Gold Limited. Senco Gold Limited is proposing to acquire 68% of the August Jewellery Private Limited’s equity share capital for an amount aggregating to INR 680 million. In this regard, Senco Gold Limited will execute: (a) Share Subscription Agreement, (b) Shareholders’ Agreement and any other related documents, as may be required during the course of the transaction with August Jewellery Private Limited.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, August Jewellery Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 332.49 million.
